description: Coming events at Hotel Mondschein: the hotel calendar (club nights, culinary evenings, festivals, sport and culture) plus packages with fixed dates such as Chef's Night, Christmas, New Year's Eve and the Longboard Classic (kind: package, date = arrival, end_date = departure). Optionally between two dates or one category (kulinarik, musik_party, fest, sport_kultur). Returns kind, dates, times, title, short text, price, guests only, sold out and the page URL. Club DJs: get_club_lineup.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

name: list_events

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.
